seo.title: Slack integration | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect Slack to Steps AI so your team hears about handoffs, new leads and important orders in the Slack workspace they already use.

hero.title: Keep your team in the loop in Slack.
hero.body: Connect Slack so your team hears about the conversations that matter, such as a customer asking for a person or a large order coming in, in the workspace they already use.
hero.reassurance: Connected once. Used in skills and workflows. Your team stays informed.

lines.text: I would like to speak to someone about a bulk order.
Of course. I have let our team know and someone will join this chat shortly.

useCases.title: What you can do with Slack connected.
useCases.intro: Use Slack as a step in your workflows and agent skills.

items.title: Alert your team to handoffs
items.body: Let your team know in Slack when a customer asks for a person, so the reply does not wait.

items.title: Share important orders
items.body: Post a message when a high-value order or a refund comes in from your store.

items.title: Flag new leads
items.body: Tell your sales team when the agent captures a lead worth following up.

setup.title: Connect Slack in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Slack
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Slack. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Slack to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Use it in a workflow or skill
items.body: Add a Slack step to a workflow, or use it in a flow skill, and choose what it should do.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The actions available for Slack depend on your setup. We will show you exactly what it can do in your demo.
Workflows save as drafts until you switch them on.

items.q: Where do I use Slack after connecting it?
items.a: In the workflow builder and in flow skills, where a connected app can be chosen as an action.

items.q: Do I need to write code?
items.a: No. You choose steps from menus. Advanced options such as webhooks are there if your team wants them.

cta.title: See Steps AI work with Slack.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using Slack and your own information.
